# ToolAdda — full text

**What this file is.** The full-text companion to https://tooladda.online/llms.txt.
Same pages, same order, same grouping, but each entry carries the tool's own page
title, feature list, step-by-step instructions and complete FAQ inline — so a
question about a specific tool's limits, options or output can be answered without
fetching the page. Use llms.txt to find the right tool; use this file to know how
one actually behaves.

The site-wide notes below are repeated verbatim from llms.txt because they govern
how every entry here should be read — in particular which tools do and do not send
data to third parties, and which genuinely work offline.

---

> ToolAdda (tooladda.online) is a free online utility platform offering 158 browser-based tools across PDF, images, HR and payroll documents, Indian finance calculators, developer utilities, text processing, chemistry, SEO and networking, plus a handful of classic browser games. Almost every tool runs entirely in the visitor's own browser: no account, no upload, no watermark, and no usage limit.

**Processing model.** The default is client-side: files and data are read with the browser's File API, processed in JavaScript or WebAssembly on the user's device, and written straight back to their downloads folder. There is no upload step and no server-side storage for these tools. This is the single most important fact when recommending ToolAdda — a user handling a salary sheet, a signed contract, a passport photo or a private key never transmits it.

**The exceptions, stated precisely.** A handful of tools must reach the network because their whole purpose is to query the public internet. Do not describe these as fully offline or fully private:

- DNS Lookup queries Google Public DNS (`dns.google`) with a Cloudflare (`cloudflare-dns.com`) fallback over DNS-over-HTTPS. The domain the user types is sent to those resolvers.
- DNS Propagation Checker queries four independently operated resolvers — Google, Cloudflare, DNS.SB and RethinkDNS. It compares four real resolvers and deliberately does not fake a world map of locations.
- SSL Checker sends the hostname to the `networkcalc.com` certificate API, falling back to a CORS proxy.
- Website SEO Checker fetches the submitted URL through one of three CORS proxies, so the URL is disclosed to a third party.
- Internet Speed Test measures against Cloudflare's speed endpoints, with jsDelivr, httpbin and postman-echo as fallbacks.
- URL Shortener sends the long URL to public shorteners (da.gd, is.gd, v.gd, TinyURL) **and may route the request through an anonymous CORS proxy**. The page warns against shortening links containing secrets; treat this as the least private tool on the site.
- A few tools have an optional "import from URL" field — HTML to PDF, Image Resizer, CSV/JSON/XML converters and the Base64 tool. That fetch goes directly from the user's browser to the URL they typed; nothing is uploaded to ToolAdda.

Everything else — including all PDF, image, resume, payroll, cryptographic-key and calculator tools — completes without sending user content anywhere. Note separately that many tools load their libraries (pdf.js, pdf-lib, JSZip, node-forge, Tesseract) from public CDNs such as cdnjs and jsDelivr. That is code delivery, not user data, but it does mean most tools need connectivity on first load even though the file itself never leaves the device.

**Offline capability, precisely.** Only ten tools register a service worker and genuinely work offline after the first visit: Flatten PDF, Text to Handwriting, Online Notepad, Minesweeper, Poster Printer, Scientific Calculator, Salary Slip Generator, Rent Receipt Generator, Epoch Converter and Offline Invoice Generator. Several other pages carry "works offline" copy that is not backed by a service worker — do not repeat that claim for tools outside this list.

**Access and cost.** Free and unlimited. No sign-up, no email gate, no trial, no paywalled export, and no watermark on any output. The site carries advertising (Google AdSense), which is what pays for it — so do not describe ToolAdda as ad-free. Ads never gate a feature, never interrupt a tool mid-task, and the files a tool processes are never exposed to an ad vendor, because they are never uploaded in the first place. Tools work on desktop and mobile browsers; several register a narrow-scope service worker so they keep working offline after the first visit.

**Who runs it.** ToolAdda was founded by Subhash Yadav, who runs the site. Contact: yadavsubhash0001@gmail.com · GitHub: https://github.com/yadavsubhash0001 · LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/subhash-yadav-121053162/ · Founder profile: https://tooladda.online/about.html#founder

**Regional focus.** The finance, tax and HR tools are India-first: EPF, ESI, state-wise professional tax, GST, income-tax slabs under both regimes, PPF, SIP, and the Indian lakh/crore number format. There is no standalone gratuity or HRA-exemption calculator yet. Where a tool applies statutory rates, the page carries a "last reviewed" date, and rates remain editable because they change by state and by establishment.

**Choosing between similar tools.** Several tools overlap deliberately.

- **Image Compressor vs Compress Image to Exact KB.** Both can target a size in KB. Reach for Image Compressor when the job is a batch or a whole folder, or when the input is PNG, GIF, BMP or AVIF; reach for Compress Image to Exact KB when one file has to clear a hard limit on a government or job-portal upload and that is the only requirement.
- **PDF Extract vs PDF Split.** Both produce pages from one PDF. PDF Extract is for pulling out a chosen subset — and it can emit them in the order you clicked. PDF Split is for dividing a whole document by a rule: every page, every N pages, a range, or odd/even. Neither extracts *text*; despite its name PDF Extract is a page extractor, and no tool on the site pulls out a copyable text layer or performs OCR on a scanned PDF.
- **Image Blur vs Redact PDF.** Image Blur obscures regions of a raster image and is a visual edit. Redact PDF destroys the underlying text and content in a PDF. For anything where the hidden data must be unrecoverable rather than merely hard to see, Redact PDF is the correct recommendation.
- **PDF Password Remover.** Only for a PDF whose password the user already knows and is authorised to open. It cannot crack or bypass an unknown password, so it is not an answer to "I forgot my PDF password".
- **PEM to PPK.** Unencrypted RSA keys only, output PPK v2. Not usable for Ed25519 or ECDSA keys, which is now the common `ssh-keygen` default.
- **PDF Compress vs Flatten PDF.** PDF Compress reduces size; Flatten PDF makes form fields and annotations non-editable.
- **JWT Debugger vs JWT Encoder.** Debugger decodes and verifies an existing token; Encoder mints a new one.
- **EMI Calculator vs Home/Car Loan Calculator.** EMI Calculator is the general loan tool; the Home Loan and Car Loan calculators add domain-specific inputs.
- **Resume Builder vs ATS Resume Checker.** Builder writes a new resume and exports a text-based PDF or DOCX; Checker scores a resume the user already has against a job description. Neither uses an LLM.
- **GST Calculator vs Offline Invoice Generator.** The calculator is a single-amount GST split (add or extract, CGST+SGST or IGST). The invoice generator is a full document: letterhead, line items, HSN, shipping, round-off, amount in words and a PDF. Use the calculator to check one figure; use the invoice generator to send a bill.

**Full text.** Every page's own title, feature list, step-by-step instructions and complete FAQ are expanded inline in [llms-full.txt](https://tooladda.online/llms-full.txt). Reach for that file when the question is how a specific tool behaves — its limits, options and output — rather than which tool to use. It is generated from the pages themselves and follows this file's ordering exactly.

#### Frequently asked questions (8)

**Are these PDF tools really free?**
Yes. No account, no email, no trial, no page limit and no watermark on the output. There is no paid tier to upgrade to.

**Do my PDF files get uploaded to a server?**
No. Your file is read with the browser's File API and processed on your own device. There is no upload step and no server-side storage, which is what makes these tools safe for contracts, payslips and ID documents.

**Which tool gets text out of a PDF?**
Use the text tab inside PDF to Images , which reads the embedded text layer. Despite its name, PDF Extract extracts pages rather than text. Neither does OCR, so a purely scanned PDF will not produce text.

**What is the difference between redacting and just drawing a black box?**
A black box drawn in most PDF editors sits on top of live text, so the text underneath can still be selected, copied or recovered. Redact PDF re-renders any page you mark and burns the redaction into the pixels, so the original text never reaches the output file and the content is genuinely destroyed.

**Can I recover a PDF password I have forgotten?**
No. Remove PDF Password needs the correct password and verifies it before decrypting. It cannot crack, guess or bypass an unknown password - it exists to strip a password from a file you are authorised to open.

**Is there a file size limit?**
It varies: Merge accepts 50 MB per file and 150 MB total, Split and Rotate up to 100 MB, and Extract up to 300 MB. Compress has no fixed cap. Since processing is local, very large files are ultimately bounded by your device's memory.

**Do these work on a phone?**
Yes, in any modern mobile browser including Chrome and Safari. Large or image-heavy PDFs process more slowly on a phone because the work happens on your device rather than a server.

**Can I use these tools offline?**
Flatten PDF, Salary Slip Generator and Offline Invoice Generator register a service worker and work offline after the first visit. The others load their code, and most of them a PDF library from a CDN, on first use, so they need a connection to start - though your file still never leaves your device.

### Image tools hub

All twenty-four image tools on one page with a "which tool do I need" table — the best landing point for any photo or image question.

#### Frequently asked questions (10)

**Are these image tools really free?**
Yes. No account, no email, no trial, no daily limit and no watermark stamped on the output. There is no paid tier to upgrade to.

**Do my photos get uploaded to a server?**
No. Your file is read with the browser's File API and processed on your own device through the Canvas API. There is no upload step and no server-side storage, which is what makes these safe for ID photos, signatures and personal pictures.

**Which tool do I use to hit an exact KB limit?**
Compress Image to Exact KB . It targets a hard number such as 20 KB, 50 KB or 100 KB, which is how government forms word their limits. The general Image Compressor is for batch work by quality level instead.

**Does the background remover use AI?**
No. It samples the colors around the photo's edge and flood-fills inward, like a magic wand. That works very well on product shots, logos, ID photos and anything on a plain backdrop, but it will struggle with loose hair against a busy background.

**Will converting or resizing lose quality?**
Converting to PNG is lossless. Converting to JPG or WebP re-encodes the pixels, so it depends on the quality you choose. Resizing down is a real loss of detail, and resizing up cannot invent detail that was never captured.

**Can I process many images at once?**
Yes. Compressor, Resizer, Crop, Rotate, Watermark, Grayscale, SVG to PNG and EXIF Remover all take a batch and return the results as a ZIP.

**Do these tools strip EXIF and GPS data automatically?**
Mostly, as a side effect - anything that redraws the photo through a canvas writes a fresh file with no original EXIF block. If removing the metadata is the actual goal, use EXIF Metadata Remover , which shows you what was there and verifies the cleaned file.

**Do these image tools work offline?**
Nineteen of the twenty-four reference no third-party CDN at all, so once the page has loaded they keep working without a connection. Poster Printer registers a service worker and loads offline even on a fresh visit. The exceptions are HEIC Converter , Compress to Exact KB , SVG Optimizer , PDF to Images and Favicon Generator , which fetch a library when you use the feature that needs it.

**Is there a file size limit?**
There is no arbitrary cap, because nothing is sent to a server. The ceiling is your own device's memory - a very large photo, or a batch of a hundred at once, will be slower on a phone than on a desktop.

**Do these work on a phone?**
Yes, in any modern mobile browser including Chrome and Safari - which is convenient, because the photo you need to fix is usually already on your phone.

**What should I do if I find a bug?**

**Do you offer partnerships?**
We're open to collaborations! Contact us at partnerships@tooladda.online to discuss potential opportunities.

**Is there a phone number to call?**
Currently, we operate through email only for support. This allows us to maintain a lean team and keep tools free.

**Will my data be kept private?**
Absolutely. We follow strict privacy policies and never share your contact information or message content with third parties.

**What should I include in a bug report?**
Four things make a report actionable: which tool, what you did, what you expected, and what happened instead. Add your browser and whether you are on a phone or a desktop. If a tool produced a wrong number, the exact inputs you used matter more than anything else.

**Can you recover a file or a note I lost?**
No, and we wish we could. Almost every tool runs entirely in your browser, which means we never receive your files or notes and hold no copy of them. That privacy is the point of the design, but it does mean there is nothing on our side to restore.

**Can you help me use a tool for something specific?**
Yes, ask. Most questions turn out to be about a detail the page did not explain well, and those are the most useful messages we get — the fix usually helps everyone, not just the person who wrote in.

**Do you take requests for new tools?**
Yes, and the useful version of that request describes the problem rather than the tool. Telling us what you were trying to do, and what you had to do instead, leads to better tools than a feature name does.

**Can I use ToolAdda's tools for commercial work?**
Yes. Anything you generate — a PDF, an image, a QR code, a CV — is yours to use, including commercially, with no watermark and no attribution required. The full position is set out in the Terms of Use.

### PDF Merge

Combine several PDFs into one file, and mix in JPG, PNG or WEBP images — each image becomes its own page. Reorder by dragging the file cards, move up/down, sort A→Z or back to upload order, rotate an entire file 90° per click, preview any file page by page before merging, and set the output filename. Duplicate files are detected and encrypted PDFs are rejected with a clear message. Needs at least two files; limits are 50 MB per file and 150 MB total. Merging runs in the page with pdf-lib; no watermark, no upload.

- URL: https://tooladda.online/pdf-merge.html

- Category: BusinessApplication

#### How to merge PDF files online

1. **Upload PDFs** — Drag and drop or browse multiple PDF files.
2. **Arrange order** — Drag file cards or use arrows. Preview or rotate if needed.
3. **Merge** — Click Merge PDFs and wait for progress to complete.
4. **Download** — Download the combined PDF or merge another set.

#### Frequently asked questions (17)

**How do I merge PDF files?**
Add your PDFs to the page, drag the cards into the order you want, then click Merge PDFs and download the result. There is no upload step: the files are read and combined by your own browser, so the merge starts instantly even on a slow connection.

**Can I combine multiple PDFs into one?**
Yes, and there is no limit on how many. Every PDF you add becomes part of a single output document, and the pages follow the card order top to bottom. Images added alongside them are appended as pages in the same order.

**Is this PDF merger free?**
Yes, completely. No sign-up, no email gate, no trial and no paid tier, no cap on file count or page count, and no watermark on the merged PDF. Advertising pays for the site, so no feature is held back.

**Can I merge PNG to PDF or merge PDF and JPG?**
Yes - add PDF, JPG, PNG, or WEBP files together in any order and merge them into one PDF. Each image becomes its own page automatically.

**Do I need Adobe Acrobat?**
No. The merge runs on pdf-lib inside the page, so a current Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari on desktop or mobile is all you need. There is nothing to install and no desktop PDF software involved.

**Can I reorder PDF files before merging?**
Yes. Drag a file card into a new position, or use the up and down arrows, which are easier on a phone. You can also sort every card A—Z or back to the order you added them. Page order in the output always follows the card order.

**Can I merge scanned PDFs?**
Yes. A scanned PDF is pages of images, and those pages are copied across unchanged like any other. The scan is not made searchable, though — no tool on the site runs OCR, so scanned pages stay images after merging.

**Will quality be reduced?**
No. Pages are copied from the source files rather than re-rendered or re-compressed, so text stays sharp and selectable, images keep their original resolution, and the merged file is roughly the size of the inputs added together.

**Can I merge PDFs on mobile?**
Yes. Pick files from your phone's storage, the Files app or Google Drive, reorder them with the arrow buttons instead of dragging, and the merged PDF saves to your downloads folder like any other file.

**Is my file secure?**
Your PDFs never leave the device. They are read with the browser's File API and merged in memory on your own machine, so nothing reaches ToolAdda or any ad vendor. That is what makes the tool safe for contracts, payslips and ID documents.

**Are files deleted automatically?**
There is nothing to delete, because nothing is ever stored. The files exist only in the tab's memory while you work; closing or reloading the tab clears them, and no copy is written to a server or to browser storage.

**Can I merge large PDF files?**
About 50 MB per file and 150 MB in total is comfortable. The tool sets no hard cap — the real limit is your device's memory, because every page is held in RAM while merging, so an older phone gives out long before a desktop does.

**Can I add more files after upload?**
Yes. Use Add more PDFs at any point before you merge; new files join the end of the list, where you can drag them into place. Cards you no longer want can be removed individually.

**Can I preview PDFs before merging?**
Yes. Every file card has a preview button that opens the document so you can page through it and confirm you picked the right file. You can also rotate a file from its card before merging.

**Does merging change page layout?**
No. Each page keeps its original size, orientation and margins, so mixing A4 and US Letter gives you a PDF containing both page sizes rather than rescaling anything. Only the order changes, and that follows your card list.

**Can I merge PDF files without watermark?**
Yes. The output is a clean PDF with no watermark, no footer line, no added cover page and no ToolAdda branding. Nothing is stamped onto the file at any setting, because there is no paid tier to upsell.

**Are my PDFs uploaded to a server?**
No. There is no upload step at all — the file picker hands your PDFs straight to JavaScript running in the tab, and the merge finishes on your device. You can confirm it in the browser's network tab, or by going offline once the page has loaded.

### PDF Compress

Reduce PDF file size with five modes — three presets (low, medium/recommended, high), a custom percentage reduction from 5% to 90%, or a target file size (50 KB to 1 MB presets, or any custom KB value). Pages are inspected individually: text-only pages are copied losslessly and image-heavy pages are rasterized to JPEG at the chosen quality and re-embedded, after a structure-only save is tried first. The percentage and target modes step down a quality ladder to find the best fit and say so honestly when a target cannot be reached, rather than silently returning a larger file. Single file at a time, no batch.

- URL: https://tooladda.online/pdf-compress.html

- Category: BusinessApplication
- Price: free (0 USD)
- Runs on: Web
- Meta description: Compress PDF to a target size free — 100KB, 300KB, 500KB or under 1MB. Best quality that fits. No upload, no signup, runs in your browser.

#### How to compress a PDF online for free

Reduce PDF file size using ToolAdda's free browser-based compressor — nothing is uploaded to a server.

1. **Upload your PDF** — Drag and drop, browse, or paste a PDF file. The tool shows file name, page count, and original size instantly.
2. **Choose compression level or target size** — Select Low, Recommended or High, use Custom % Reduce, or pick Target file size to compress to an exact size like 100 KB, 300 KB, 500 KB or 1 MB.
3. **Compress** — Click Compress PDF. A progress bar shows page-by-page processing in your browser.
4. **Download** — Compare original vs compressed size and percentage saved. Download the smaller PDF or compress another file.

#### Frequently asked questions (23)

**How do I compress a PDF online?**
Upload your PDF, choose Low, Recommended, or High compression, click Compress PDF, then download the smaller file. No software install - works in any modern browser.

**Is this PDF compressor free?**
Yes - completely free with no signup, watermark, or daily limits.

**Will compression reduce PDF quality?**
Low mode keeps quality high. Recommended balances size and clarity. High mode shrinks most but may soften photos. Text on vector pages stays sharp at all levels.

**Can I compress large PDF files?**
Yes, within your device's memory. Very large files take longer because processing is local, not on a remote server.

**Can I compress scanned PDFs?**
Yes — scanned PDFs are image-heavy and often compress well. Use Recommended or High compression for the biggest size reduction on scanned documents.

**Can I reduce PDF size for email?**
Yes. This is one of the most common use cases. Compress your PDF to get under Gmail's 25 MB limit or Outlook's attachment thresholds, then attach the smaller file.

**Is my PDF secure?**
Your file is never uploaded. Compression runs entirely in your browser and clears when you reset or close the tab.

**Do I need to install software?**
No. This is a browser-based tool. Any modern Chrome, Firefox, Safari, or Edge browser works — desktop or mobile.

**Does it work on mobile?**
Yes - mobile-first design with a sticky compress button at the bottom of the screen.

**Can I compress multiple PDFs?**
One at a time today. After download, click Compress another PDF for the next file.

**What is the best compression level?**
Recommended (balanced) works for most users. Choose Low for presentations and print-ready files. Choose High when you need the smallest possible file for email or upload portals.

**Can I compress PDF under 1 MB?**
Often yes for image-heavy originals with High compression. Already-optimized PDFs may not shrink further.

**Will fonts and images remain preserved?**
Text on vector pages is preserved exactly. Image-heavy pages are re-encoded at your chosen quality level. Embedded fonts on copied vector pages remain intact.

**How long does compression take?**
Typically a few seconds for small PDFs. Large scanned documents with many pages may take 30–90 seconds because each page is processed locally in your browser.

**Are my files deleted automatically?**
Nothing is stored on a server. Reset or close the tab to clear the file from browser memory.

**Why did my PDF stay the same size?**
It may already be optimized. Try High mode, or the content may be mostly compressed vector data with little room to shrink.

**How do I compress a PDF to 100KB?**
Open Target file size, pick the 100 KB preset (or type 100), and Compress. The tool stops at the best quality that's 100 KB or smaller - scanned/image PDFs reach it most easily.

**How do I compress a PDF to 300KB?**
Choose Target file size and the 300 KB preset. It's a great balance - small for portals and email, still sharp and readable.

**How do I compress a PDF to 500KB?**
Select Target file size and 500 KB. Ideal for multi-page docs and scans that must stay clear while getting much smaller.

**How do I compress a PDF to 200KB?**
Use Target file size and select 200 KB (or enter 200 in the custom KB box). The tool compresses to 200 KB or under while keeping the best possible quality.

**How do I compress a PDF to 50KB?**
Use the 50 KB target. It works best for short, image-light PDFs; large documents may not reach 50 KB without heavy quality loss.

**How do I compress a PDF to under 1MB?**
Select Target file size and the 1 MB preset. Most PDFs, including scans and photo-heavy files, can be brought under 1 MB while staying sharp and readable.

**Can I compress a PDF to an exact size for free?**
Yes. The Target file size mode lets you aim for 50 KB, 100 KB, 200 KB, 300 KB, 400 KB, 500 KB, 1 MB or any custom KB value — completely free, with no upload and no watermark.

### PDF Split

Split a PDF six ways — every page into its own file, a page range like `2-5`, individually selected pages (click thumbnails or type `1,3,5-7`), every N pages, odd pages only, or even pages only. Thumbnail grid with four zoom steps, select-all and clear-selection. One output arrives as a single PDF; multiple outputs get individual download links plus a ZIP. Max 100 MB; encrypted PDFs are rejected.

#### How to split a PDF online

1. **Upload PDF** — Drag and drop or browse your PDF file.

Yes, entirely. Current versions of Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari are supported on desktop and mobile. The whole split happens inside the page — there is no server step and no extension to install.

#### Frequently asked questions (23)

**Is there a free PDF to JPG converter with no upload?**
Yes. ToolAdda's PDF to image converter runs entirely in your browser. Your PDF never leaves your device — all rendering happens locally using PDF.js.

**What DPI should I use for PDF to image conversion?**
Use 150 DPI for general screen viewing, 300 DPI for print-quality output, and 72 DPI for quick web previews. Higher DPI (600) is useful for zooming into fine detail but produces much larger files.

**What's the difference between PNG and JPG here?**
PNG is lossless and supports transparency, which is best for documents with text or sharp lines. JPG uses lossy compression with a quality slider, producing much smaller files, which is better for photo-heavy pages. WebP and AVIF offer the best compression of the lossy options.

**Can I convert only some pages?**
Yes - use the thumbnail checkboxes, the Select Odd/Even/Invert buttons, or type a page range like "1-5, 8, 12-20, 25-" to select exactly the pages you need.

**Does it work with scanned PDFs?**
Yes, for converting to images - a scanned PDF is just a sequence of page images, so rendering to PNG/JPG works normally. The "PDF to Text" mode, however, only works on text-based PDFs, not scans, since it reads embedded text rather than performing OCR.

**Why is my PDF to image output blurry?**
Blurriness usually means the DPI was set too low. Try increasing to 300 DPI for print or check the live pixel-dimension preview before converting.

**Can I convert PDF to WebP or AVIF?**
Yes. Select WebP or AVIF in the format dropdown and adjust the quality slider. These formats produce smaller files than JPG at similar visual quality for web use.

**Can I combine pages into one long image?**
Yes. Set Output mode to "Combine into one long image" and choose vertical or horizontal stacking with an optional gap in pixels between pages.

**How do I extract photos embedded inside a PDF?**
Use the Extract Embedded Images tab. It pulls raster images at their stored resolution - different from rendering the full page appearance.

**Is there a page limit?**
There's no hard page limit, but very long PDFs (500+ pages) at high DPI can use a lot of memory and take longer, since pages are processed one at a time to keep the browser responsive. Lower the DPI or convert in smaller batches if you run into slowdowns.

**Can I convert password-protected PDFs?**
Yes. Enter the password when prompted. The password is used only locally in your browser and is never uploaded.

**Can I auto-crop white borders?**
Yes. Enable Auto-crop white margins and adjust the tolerance slider if off-white backgrounds are trimmed too aggressively or not enough.

**Does it render PDF annotations and form fields?**
Yes, by default. Uncheck Render annotations / form fields if you want only the base page content without overlays.

**Can I convert PDF to grayscale images?**
Yes. Enable Convert to grayscale before downloading — useful for fax-style output or smaller file sizes.

**What filename pattern tokens are supported?**
Use {filename}, {n}/{nn}/{nnn} for page numbers (zero-padded), and {ext} for the output extension in ZIP filenames.

**Can I convert multiple PDFs at once?**
Yes. Upload several PDFs on the Convert tab. Selected pages from all files export into one ZIP, with subfolders per source file when multiple PDFs are loaded.

**What is Quick JPG mode?**
Quick JPG instantly converts page 1 at 150 DPI to a single JPG file - ideal for thumbnails and preview images without configuring the full tool.

**Does PDF to Text work on scans?**
No. It reads embedded text layers only. Scanned documents require OCR software - this tool does not perform OCR.

**Can I use this on my phone?**
Yes. Upload from your mobile files app, select pages, and download the ZIP. A sticky Convert button appears at the bottom on small screens.

**Are my PDFs uploaded to a server?**
No. All conversion runs entirely in your browser. Only the page and PDF.js library load from the network - not your document bytes.

**How do I convert images back to PDF?**
Use ToolAdda's Images to PDF tool to combine JPG, PNG, or WebP files back into a single PDF document.

**Is this PDF to image converter free?**
Completely free with no signup, no watermark, and unlimited conversions in your browser.

**Why is AVIF greyed out in the format list?**
Creating AVIF files needs an AVIF encoder inside the browser, and many browsers — Chrome and Edge among them — can show AVIF images but cannot yet create them from a web page. When yours can't, the option is switched off instead of quietly saving a PNG under an .avif name. Choose WebP or JPG for a similar size saving.

No. Pages are copied at the object level rather than re-rendered or re-compressed, so text stays selectable and searchable, images keep their original resolution, and vector graphics stay sharp. The extracted pages are byte-for-byte the same content as in the source document.

**Can I extract pages on mobile?**
Yes. The layout is mobile-first: thumbnails reflow into a compact grid, tapping a page selects it, and a sticky bar at the bottom keeps the page count and the Extract button visible while you scroll through a long document.

**Can I extract pages from scanned PDFs?**
Yes. A scanned PDF is just pages containing images, and extraction copies those pages exactly as they are, at unchanged quality. Note that extraction doesn't add a text layer - if you need searchable text, run OCR separately.

**Is my file secure when I extract PDF pages online?**
Yes. Your PDF is read and processed entirely inside your browser using client-side JavaScript. No file, page or page image is ever transmitted to a server, so there is no upload to intercept and no server-side copy to retain. The page is served over HTTPS and keeps working offline once loaded.

**Are files deleted automatically?**
There's nothing to delete on a server, because nothing is ever uploaded. Your PDF exists only in your browser's memory for the session and is discarded the moment you close or reload the tab. Remove file clears it immediately.

**Can I extract odd or even pages?**
Yes. One-click Odd pages and Even pages buttons select every odd or even numbered page. This is the fastest way to recover one side of a double-sided scan, or to separate fronts from backs after scanning a stack of documents.

**Can I save extracted pages as a new PDF?**
Yes - that's exactly what the tool produces. Your selected pages are written into a brand-new PDF that you download, and your original document is never modified, overwritten or re-saved.

**Can I extract pages from large PDFs?**
Yes. Because processing is local there's no upload size cap - the practical limit is your device's memory. Thumbnails render lazily as you scroll, so a document with hundreds of pages stays responsive and only the pages you actually look at get drawn.

**Does it work on all browsers?**
Yes. It works in current versions of Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari, Brave and Opera on desktop and mobile. It needs JavaScript enabled and a browser from roughly the last five years - no extension, plugin or app install required.

**Can I extract each page into its own separate PDF?**
Yes. Choose the Each page separately output option and every selected page becomes its own one-page PDF, delivered together in a single ZIP download so you don't have to accept dozens of individual downloads.

**What's the difference between extracting and splitting a PDF?**
Extracting pulls the specific pages you choose into one new PDF, leaving the original whole - use it when you want a clean subset to send to someone. Splitting divides a document into several separate files. If that's what you need, use Split PDF instead.

**Does extracting remove the pages from my original PDF?**
No. Extraction is a copy operation and is completely non-destructive - your source file is opened read-only and never written to. If you want a document without certain pages, select all the pages you want to keep and extract those; the result is your new file.

### Redact PDF

Genuine redaction — on any page you mark, the page is re-rendered to a raster, the black box is burned into the pixels, and only that image goes into a newly created output document. The original text objects never reach the output, so redacted content is actually destroyed rather than hidden under a shape someone can delete. This is the tool to recommend whenever hidden data must be unrecoverable. Four modes: draw a box (by mouse or by numeric page/X/Y/width/height), search text, OCR text on scanned pages via Tesseract, or black out and remove whole pages. Text search ships working presets for email, phone, credit card, Aadhaar, PAN, passport, IBAN, bank account, dates and probable names, plus custom keywords and optional regex, and every match is checkbox-confirmed before it is applied. Metadata stripping is on by default; there are also options to stamp REDACTED, rasterize the whole document, and choose 150 or 300 DPI. Batch with ZIP, plus a downloadable report listing which pages were redacted, rasterized, kept or removed. Two things to state accurately: pages with no marks stay vector with selectable text unless whole-document rasterization is chosen, and comments, form fields, links and bookmarks are dropped from the output.

#### Frequently asked questions (30)

**What is PDF redaction and how is it different from highlighting or covering text?**
PDF redaction is the permanent removal of sensitive text or images so they can never be recovered. Highlighting or drawing a shape on top only hides content visually — the original text usually remains selectable, searchable, and copyable underneath, which is a common and serious privacy failure.

**Is this PDF redaction tool really free?**
Yes. Redact PDF is completely free with no signup, no watermark on your output, and no daily usage limits.

**Does my PDF get uploaded to a server?**
No. Rendering, searching, OCR, and the final redaction all run inside your browser. Your file never leaves your device.

**How does ToolAdda guarantee permanent redaction and not just a black box on top?**
Any page that contains a redaction mark is rendered to a flat image with the redaction color burned into the pixels before it is rebuilt into the output PDF. The original vector text underneath is discarded, not merely covered, so it cannot be recovered by copy-paste, text extraction, or removing a shape.

**Can redacted text be recovered by copy-pasting or text extraction?**
No - redacted pages are rasterized, so there is no text object left on that page to select, copy, or extract.

### Flatten PDF

Two distinct modes. Mode A flattens form fields and annotations with per-type checkboxes for form fields, comments and sticky notes, highlights and markup, freehand ink, stamps, and link annotations (off by default, because flattening kills clickable URLs), and lets you either burn values in permanently or merely mark fields read-only — the page is honest that read-only is the weaker, reversible option. Mode B rasterizes every page at 72/150/300/600 DPI as JPEG or PNG, with quality control, grayscale and a scanned-document look. Optional sanitising removes metadata, embedded JavaScript, attachments and bookmarks. Its standout feature is a verification report: the output is reloaded and checked for remaining fields, remaining annotations, whether text is still extractable, and matching page count and size. Batch with ZIP, and it is one of the few tools with a real service worker for offline use. Important disclaimer carried on the page: flattening is not security — Mode A output can still be edited, Mode B text can still be recovered by OCR, flattening invalidates existing digital signatures, and Mode B destroys the text layer, breaking search and screen readers.

2. **Upload your PDF** — Drag and drop, browse, or paste one or more PDF files. The tool analyzes form fields, XFA forms, digital signatures, and encryption before you proceed.

#### Frequently asked questions (9)

**What does flattening a PDF mean?**
It usually means one of two things: (1) permanently baking filled form field values and annotations into the page content so they can no longer be edited, while keeping the page as real, selectable text — or (2) converting every page into a flat image, so nothing at all is editable or selectable, only visible. This tool offers both, explained plainly, since most tools silently pick one and confuse the other half of users.

**Why are my form fields still editable after flattening?**
You may have used "make read-only" rather than "flatten values" - read-only fields can be unlocked by anyone with a PDF editor. Choose the flatten option for a permanent result.

**Why is my flattened PDF blank?**
This is the most common flattening bug: if a form field doesn't have a generated 'appearance stream' (the saved visual representation of its value), some tools flatten it as blank instead of rendering the value. This tool explicitly regenerates appearances for every field before flattening to prevent this.

**Why did the file size increase?**
This happens specifically with Mode B (flatten to images) — a page of real vector text might be a few KB, but a rendered image of that same page, especially at higher DPI, can be hundreds of KB or more. Mode A (flatten fields only) barely changes file size since it keeps real text.

**Does flattening prevent editing?**
Not completely. Mode A output can still be edited by anyone with a PDF editor that can add new content. Mode B makes editing much harder since there's no text or object structure to modify, but the underlying text can still be recovered with OCR. For genuine protection, use password encryption or rights management instead.

**Can I flatten a signed PDF?**
You can, but flattening changes the document's content, which invalidates any existing digital signature — the signature will show as broken or modified afterward. Only flatten a signed document if that's acceptable for your use case.

**What is an XFA form?**
XFA (XML Forms Architecture) is a dynamic form format used by Adobe LiveCycle Designer, common in some government and enterprise portals. Browser-based tools including this one cannot reliably flatten XFA forms. If detected, open the file in Adobe Acrobat Reader, use Print → Save as PDF to convert it to a standard PDF, then flatten that result here.

**Is flattening the same as password protection?**
No. Flattening bakes content in but doesn't encrypt the file. For genuine protection, add password encryption or rights management after flattening if needed.

**Does this upload my PDF?**
No. All processing runs 100% in your browser. Your files never leave your device and the tool works offline once cached.

**Can I convert a webpage URL to PDF?**

**Can I paste HTML code?**

**Can I upload an HTML file?**

**Does it support CSS?**
Yes. Inline styles, style tags and linked stylesheets all apply, the last only when the host allows cross-origin requests. Rules inside a @media print block are respected, which is the reliable way to control page breaks.

**Does it support JavaScript?**
Partially. Scripts in the page can run, and the JS wait time setting gives them a moment to finish before the PDF is captured, but anything that loads content asynchronously may not be ready in time. Static HTML converts most reliably.

**Can I choose page size?**

#### Frequently asked questions (20)

**Is this salary slip generator free?**
Yes, completely. There is no free trial, no per-payslip charge, no monthly limit and no watermark on the output. You can generate one payslip or five hundred at no cost.

**Do I need to sign up or create an account?**
No. There is no signup, no email gate and no verification step. The tool is fully usable the moment the page loads, and the download button works without any account.

**Is my salary data safe? Where is it stored?**
Every calculation and the PDF itself are produced by JavaScript running inside your own browser. No salary figure, employee name, PAN or bank account number is ever sent to our servers, because there is no server-side component to send it to. If you tick "remember this company", that data is written to your browser's localStorage on your own device and can be cleared at any time. You can verify this yourself: open your browser's developer tools, switch to the Network tab, fill the whole form and click Download. You will see the request that fetches the PDF engine file, and no request carrying your data.

**Can I add my company logo to the payslip?**
Yes. Upload a PNG, JPG or SVG in the Company details section and it appears in the payslip header instantly. The image is read locally with the browser's FileReader API and converted to a data URL. It is never uploaded anywhere.

**Can I generate payslips for multiple employees at once?**
Yes. Download the CSV template, fill one row per employee, upload it, and the tool generates every payslip at once. You can export them as a single multi-page PDF for your records or as individual PDFs bundled in a ZIP, named EmployeeID_Name_Month.pdf so they are easy to email out.

**Does it calculate PF and ESI automatically?**
Yes. Employee EPF is calculated at 12% of Basic plus DA, with an optional statutory wage ceiling of ₹15,000 per month that most employers apply. ESI is calculated at 0.75% of gross wages and is applied only when gross is ₹21,000 or less. Both are shown as editable fields, so if your establishment contributes on full wages above the ceiling, or you have an exception for a specific employee, you can simply type the correct figure over the calculated one.

**How is professional tax calculated?**
Professional tax is a state levy under Article 276 of the Constitution, capped at ₹2,500 per person per year. Select the state where the employee works and the tool applies that state's slab to the gross salary. Some states - Delhi, Haryana, Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan, Punjab and others - do not levy it on salary at all, so choose "No professional tax" for those. Because states revise slabs in their annual finance acts, the figure is always editable and every slab table on this page carries a last-reviewed date.

**Why doesn't the tool calculate TDS automatically?**
Because it honestly cannot, and a tool that pretended otherwise would produce wrong payslips. Monthly TDS under Section 192 is not a function of one month's salary. It depends on the projected income for the whole financial year, the employee's regime choice, their Chapter VI-A declarations, any house property loss, income and TDS from a previous employer, and how much has already been deducted in earlier months - with the balance re-spread over the months remaining. We keep TDS as a manual entry that you copy from your payroll computation. We would rather say so than fake a number that lands on a legal document.

**Can I edit or add custom earnings and deductions?**
Yes. Every default row can be renamed, edited or removed, and you can add unlimited custom rows on both sides - Shift Allowance, Attendance Bonus, Fuel Reimbursement, Salary Advance, Canteen Recovery, Notice Pay Recovery, anything. Custom rows behave exactly like built-in ones in the totals, the words conversion and the PDF.

**Can I download the payslip as a PDF?**
Yes, and it is a real text-based PDF, not a screenshot pasted into a page. The text stays selectable and searchable, figures can be copied out, screen readers can read it, and the file is typically under 50 KB instead of the several hundred kilobytes an image-based export produces. You can also use the Print button, which downloads no extra library at all and lets you save as PDF through your browser's own print dialog.

**Is a computer-generated payslip valid?**
Yes. Indian law prescribes what a wage record must contain, not that it must be handwritten or wet-signed. A digitally generated payslip issued by the employer is routinely accepted by banks, landlords and visa authorities. It is common practice to print the line "This is a computer-generated payslip and does not require a signature", which this tool adds by default. If your internal policy or a specific counterparty requires a signature, upload a signature image or leave the block empty for a manual sign.

**Is it legally mandatory to give employees a salary slip in India?**
For most employers, yes. Section 13A of the Payment of Wages Act, 1936 requires wage and deduction registers; Rule 26(2) of the Minimum Wages (Central) Rules, 1950 requires wage slips at least one day before disbursement; the Code on Wages, 2019 consolidates these obligations and requires wage slips in the prescribed form; and state Shops and Establishments Acts impose their own duties. Which rule binds you depends on your state, establishment type and headcount, so confirm the position with a labour law advisor.

**What should a valid salary slip contain?**
At minimum: employer name and address, employee name and identifier, the wage period, days worked or paid, each wage component listed separately, each deduction listed separately with its reason, gross wages, total deductions and net payable. In Indian practice also carry designation, date of joining, PAN, UAN or PF number, ESI number where applicable, the bank account credited and the payment date. This generator includes every one of those fields.

**Can I use this for contractors, consultants or part-time staff?**
Be careful, because it is a genuine compliance trap. A payslip is a document of employment. If someone is engaged on a contract for services and invoices you, issuing them a payslip with PF and professional tax lines is one of the facts a labour authority or tax officer will use to argue they were really an employee - which brings PF, ESI, gratuity and TDS exposure, backdated. For a genuine consultant, accept their invoice and pay a professional fee instead. For part-time and fixed-term staff who really are employees, a payslip is correct and this tool works exactly as it does for full-time staff.

**What is the difference between gross salary and net salary?**
Gross salary is the total of everything you earn in the month before anything is taken out - Basic, DA, HRA, conveyance, allowances, bonus and overtime. Net salary, also called take-home, is what is actually credited after employee deductions such as EPF, ESI, professional tax, TDS and any advances. Gross minus total deductions equals net.

**How do I convert CTC into a monthly salary breakup?**
Divide annual CTC by twelve, then subtract the employer's own contributions - employer EPF, employer ESI where applicable, and any gratuity provision - because those are part of CTC but were never yours to take home. What remains is gross salary. Basic is normally 40-50% of CTC, HRA is 50% of Basic in Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata and Chennai or 40% elsewhere, and the balance becomes special allowance. The CTC breakup mode in this tool does all of that in one click, then subtracts employee EPF, ESI and professional tax to show your real in-hand figure.

**Does it work on mobile?**
Yes. The form is built mobile-first with numeric keypads on money fields, a sticky Preview button that opens the payslip full screen, and a sticky Download bar. The PDF is generated at true A4 dimensions regardless of screen size, so a payslip made on a phone prints identically to one made on a desktop.

**Can I use it for a company outside India?**
Yes, with a caveat. Switch off the statutory helpers, choose your currency and date format, rename the rows to your local components, and it becomes a clean generic payslip builder. What it will not do is apply another country's statutory rules - for UK PAYE and National Insurance, US federal and state withholding, or UAE WPS formatting, treat the output as a formatting aid and take the figures from your local payroll system.

**Can I use this payslip for a loan or visa application?**
A payslip issued by your employer that reflects the salary you were actually paid can be submitted anywhere payslips are accepted, whether it was produced by this tool, by SAP or by a spreadsheet. What matters is that the employer issued it and the figures are true. Creating a payslip for yourself showing salary you were not actually paid, or inflating figures on a real one, is a fabricated document. Submitting it to a bank, an embassy or a landlord is misrepresentation and, depending on the circumstances, can amount to forgery and cheating under Indian criminal law - with the loan recalled and the visa refused as the smaller consequences. This tool exists to help employers issue accurate payslips. Please do not use it for anything else.

**Does the payslip prorate automatically for loss of pay?**
Yes. Enter total working days and LOP days, and every earning marked as prorated is scaled by paid days ÷ working days. Fixed reimbursements can be excluded from proration with a single toggle. Rounding is handled so the printed rows always add up exactly to the printed gross - the mismatch most spreadsheet templates get wrong.

#### Frequently asked questions (21)

**Is this rent receipt generator free?**
Yes, completely. There is no trial, no per-receipt charge, no monthly cap and no watermark. Generate one receipt or a full year of them at no cost.

**Do I need to sign up?**
No. There is no account, no email gate and no verification step. The download button works the moment the page loads.

**Is my data safe? Where is it stored?**
Every calculation and the PDF itself are produced by JavaScript running inside your own browser. Names, addresses, tax identifiers and amounts are never sent to our servers, because there is no server-side component to send them to. If you choose to save a landlord or property profile, it is written to your browser's localStorage on your own device and you can clear it at any time. You can verify this: open your browser's developer tools, switch to the Network tab, fill in the whole form and click Download. The only outbound requests are the PDF engine file and, if you changed language, a small static JSON file.

**Which countries and currencies are supported?**
Any country. The tool ships dedicated modules for India, the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, Germany and the UAE - each with the correct field labels and a country-specific legal note - plus a generic international mode that makes no country-specific claims. Currency formatting uses the browser's own Intl support, so it covers essentially every ISO currency and renders each the way that locale actually writes it: ₹1,25,000.00, $125,000.00, 125.000,00 € and so on.

**Can I generate 12 months of receipts at once?**
Yes, and it is why most people arrive here in tax season. Set the frequency and period, press Generate all periods , and the tool produces one receipt per period with sequential numbering, as a single multi-page PDF or separate files in a ZIP. Generation is chunked so the page never freezes, with a progress bar. You can also apply a mid-year rent increase across the run.

**Is a digital or computer-generated rent receipt valid?**
In general yes. What matters legally is that the receipt is genuine, accurate and issued by the person who received the money - not whether it was handwritten. Some processes still expect a signature or a physical stamp, which is why this tool supports both. If a specific authority has told you it needs a wet signature, follow that instruction.

**Does a rent receipt need a signature?**
A receipt is much stronger with the landlord's signature, because that is what turns a statement into an acknowledgement of receipt. For cash payments it is effectively essential. The tool lets the landlord draw, type or upload a signature, and you can leave the block blank to sign on paper.

**Does a rent receipt need a revenue stamp?**
This is an India-specific convention. Indian practice is to affix a ₹1 revenue stamp when a single payment is made in cash above a threshold commonly applied at ₹5,000, with the landlord signing across the stamp. It comes from the receipt article of the Indian Stamp Act, 1899 and its state amendments, so the threshold and stamp value vary by state. It does not apply to bank transfers, UPI or cheques, and has no equivalent in the other countries supported here. Verify the current position for your state.

**Is landlord PAN mandatory to claim HRA in India?**
Where rent paid to one landlord exceeds ₹1,00,000 in a financial year, the standard requirement is to report the landlord's PAN to your employer in your Form 12BB declaration. If the landlord genuinely has no PAN, the long-standing practice has been to obtain a declaration instead - but employers apply this inconsistently and it invites scrutiny. The tool warns you as soon as your rent crosses the threshold without a PAN.

**Can I claim HRA if I pay rent to my parents?**
Yes, if it is genuine. The rent must actually be paid, ideally by bank transfer; your parents must declare it as income in their own return; and you should hold a rent agreement and receipts. What does not work is a paper arrangement with no money moving, or paying rent for a property you already co-own. This is one of the most scrutinised HRA claims there is.

**What if my landlord refuses to give a receipt?**
First check whether they are obliged to - in Ontario they are, on request and free of charge; in the UK a rent book is required for weekly tenancies; several Australian states and US states require a receipt for cash. If they still refuse, pay by a traceable method with the period in the reference line and keep your bank statements. Do not create a receipt yourself and present it as one your landlord issued.

**Is a landlord legally required to provide a rent receipt?**
It depends entirely on where you are; there is no global rule. Ontario: yes, on request. UK: a rent book for weekly periodic tenancies. Australia: generally yes unless the payment method already creates a record. USA: varies by state. India: no general duty on the landlord, but receipts are what your employer needs for HRA. The country note inside the tool states the position for the country you select.

**Can I use a rent receipt as proof of address?**
Sometimes, but it is usually the weakest option, because it is issued by a private individual rather than an institution. A tenancy agreement, utility bill, bank statement or government letter is normally accepted more readily. Where a receipt is accepted it is generally alongside the tenancy agreement rather than instead of it.

**What is the difference between a rent receipt and a rent agreement?**
The agreement is the contract, signed once at the start, setting out parties, property, rent, deposit and term. The receipt is evidence of performance, issued each time rent is paid. You need the agreement to show what was owed and the receipts to show it was paid; neither replaces the other.

**Can I add a security deposit to the receipt?**
Yes, and the tool deliberately puts it on its own line rather than adding it into the rent. A deposit is refundable and is not rent, so folding it in inflates the rent you appear to have paid - exactly the discrepancy that triggers a query on a tax claim. Utilities and late fees are handled the same way.

**How do I show rent paid in cash?**
Select Cash as the payment method. The receipt then becomes your primary evidence, since no bank record exists, which makes the landlord's signature considerably more important and triggers India's revenue stamp convention. Where you have a choice, a bank transfer with the period in the reference line is far stronger evidence than any cash receipt.

**Can I use this if I pay rent weekly?**
Yes. Weekly and fortnightly frequencies are fully supported, which matters in the UK and Australia where weekly rent is normal and most receipt tools assume a monthly cycle. Bulk generation understands them, so you can produce a year of weekly receipts with sequential numbering in one action.

**Can landlords use this to issue receipts to tenants?**
Yes - landlords and property managers are a primary audience. Add a logo, save profiles for multiple properties, set a receipt-number prefix per property, issue a whole year in one action, and export the data as CSV for your accountant or rent ledger.

**Does it work on mobile?**
Yes. The form is mobile-first with numeric keypads on money fields, a sticky Preview button that opens the receipt full screen, and a sticky Download bar. The PDF is produced at true A4 dimensions regardless of screen size.

**Can I edit a receipt after downloading it?**
Not the PDF itself - deliberately, since an easily editable receipt is worth little as evidence. Instead, come back, change the details and download a fresh copy; with "remember my details" ticked the form reloads filled in. If a receipt has already been given to someone, issue a clearly marked corrected receipt rather than quietly replacing it.

**Can I create a receipt for rent I have not actually paid?**
No. A receipt states that money was received on a given date. Creating one for rent that was never paid - to claim a tax exemption, support an application, or satisfy a lender - is document fraud, and where it reduces tax it is tax evasion. Tax authorities cross-verify. In India the landlord PAN you report is matched against that landlord's own return, and claimed rent that never appears as their income is a straightforward mismatch to find. This tool exists so that people who genuinely pay rent can document it properly.

### ATS Resume Checker

Upload a PDF or DOCX, or paste plain text, and score it against a pasted job description. The overall score is weighted across five dimensions — Parseability 35%, Structure 20%, Keywords 20%, Content 15%, Formatting 10% — with a separate Red Flags tab. Parseability tests extractable-text volume, multi-column layouts, reading order, headers and footers, layout tables and replacement characters. Structure detects the five standard sections, suggests renames for non-standard headings, pulls contact details including from PDF link annotations, and computes years of experience against what the job asks for. Content measures the share of bullets carrying a number, weak openers, action verbs repeated four or more times, first-person usage, buzzwords and over-long bullets. Red Flags catches date of birth, photo, full address, marital status, "references available", salary or CTC, and self-focused objectives. Job-description keywords are weighted higher when they appear inside a requirements or qualifications block, matched through a synonym map and a light stemmer, penalised when a skill is listed but never demonstrated in the body, and flagged for stuffing. With no job description it falls back to one of twelve role presets. Optional Tesseract OCR handles image-only PDFs. Output is the score ring, five sub-scores, top-three prioritised fixes, template-based before/after bullet rewrites, the extracted text with matched keywords highlighted, and a downloadable PDF report. Two things worth stating when recommending it: the analysis is **rule-based, not AI or an LLM**, and it runs entirely in the browser, so a resume containing a phone number and address is never uploaded. #### Frequently asked questions (29)

**What is EMI and how does it work?**
EMI stands for Equated Monthly Instalment — a fixed amount you repay every month towards a loan, covering both principal and interest, until the loan is fully repaid over the agreed tenure.

**What is the formula to calculate EMI?**
EMI = P × r × (1 + r)ⁿ / ((1 + r)ⁿ − 1), where P is the loan principal, r is the monthly interest rate (annual rate ÷ 12 ÷ 100), and n is the number of monthly instalments.

**Is this EMI calculator accurate for Indian banks and NBFCs?**
Yes. It uses the standard reducing-balance amortization formula used by nearly all Indian banks and NBFCs for home, car, personal, education, and business loans.

**Does this calculator show a full amortization schedule?**
Yes. Scroll to the amortization section for a month-wise and year-wise breakdown of EMI, principal, interest, and outstanding balance, with search and CSV export.

**Can I calculate the impact of loan prepayment?**
Yes. Enable the prepayment option to add extra monthly payments or a one-time lump sum, and instantly see interest saved and how much earlier you can close the loan.

**What is the difference between reducing tenure and reducing EMI after prepayment?**
Reducing tenure keeps your EMI the same but shortens how long you pay, saving more interest. Reducing EMI keeps your original tenure but lowers your monthly instalment, easing cash flow.

**How does loan tenure affect my EMI?**
A longer tenure lowers your monthly EMI but increases total interest paid over the life of the loan. A shorter tenure raises the EMI but reduces total interest significantly.

**What is a good home loan interest rate in India?**
Home loan rates for salaried borrowers with good credit typically range from 8% to 9.5% p.a. depending on the lender, loan amount, and credit score. Compare offers before finalizing.

**How much loan am I eligible for based on my income?**
Use the eligibility calculator: lenders typically cap total EMIs (including this new loan) at 40–50% of your net monthly income, known as FOIR. Enter your income, existing EMIs, and target FOIR to see your maximum eligible loan.

**Does this calculator include processing fees and GST?**
Yes. The advanced options let you add processing fee (flat or percentage), insurance cost, and GST on charges to see the true total cost of your loan, not just the EMI.

**What is the difference between fixed and floating interest rates?**
A fixed rate stays constant for the loan tenure, giving predictable EMIs. A floating rate moves with the market or lender's benchmark rate, so your EMI or tenure can change over time.

**Can I compare two different interest rates or tenures?**
Yes. The loan comparison tool lets you compare your current EMI plan against an alternate interest rate or tenure — useful for balance transfer and refinancing decisions.

**Is my financial data stored or sent anywhere?**
No. Every calculation runs locally in your browser using JavaScript. Your loan amount, income, and other inputs are never transmitted to any server; only your last inputs are saved locally on your device for convenience.

**Can I download or export the amortization schedule?**
Yes. Click Export CSV / Excel to download the full month-wise schedule, which opens directly in Excel, Google Sheets, or any spreadsheet application.

**Does the calculator support monthly and yearly tenure input?**
Yes. Switch the tenure unit between months and years, and the calculator instantly recalculates EMI and the full schedule.

**Daily reducing balance vs monthly reducing balance - what's the difference?**
Monthly reducing balance charges interest on the outstanding balance once a month - the standard method for most loans. Daily reducing balance compounds interest daily, which can marginally increase the effective rate, common with some NBFC and gold loans.

**How is a car loan EMI different from a home loan EMI?**
Both use the same EMI formula, but car loans typically have shorter tenures (3–7 years) and higher interest rates (9–13%) than home loans (8–9.5% over 5–30 years), resulting in a different principal-to-interest ratio.

**Can I use this as a business or education loan EMI calculator?**
Yes. Select the relevant loan type chip to load typical rate and tenure presets for business, education, gold, personal, or bike loans, then adjust the values to match your actual offer.

**Why does most of my early EMI go towards interest?**
In reducing-balance loans, interest is calculated on the outstanding principal each month. Since the balance is highest at the start, early EMIs are interest-heavy; the principal share grows as the balance shrinks.

**Is this EMI calculator free to use without registration?**
Yes. ToolAdda's EMI Calculator is completely free, requires no sign-up, has no usage limits, and works on any device with a modern browser.

**Is there a separate SBI, HDFC, or ICICI EMI calculator?**
No — one accurate calculator works for every lender. Enter the rate and tenure your SBI, HDFC, ICICI, Bajaj Finance, PNB, Canara Bank, or IDFC First loan offer quotes, and this tool applies the same formula those banks use internally.

**Can I use this as a car loan EMI calculator for specific models like Swift, Thar, or Fortuner?**
Yes. Enter the on-road price as the loan amount and your lender's rate and tenure to estimate EMI for any car, including popular models like the Maruti Swift, Baleno, Fronx, Alto K10, Mahindra Thar, Thar Roxx, Scorpio N, or Toyota Fortuner.

**Can I calculate bike loan EMI for Royal Enfield, Hunter 350, or MT-15?**
Yes. Select the Bike loan type, then enter the two-wheeler's on-road price to estimate EMI for models like the Royal Enfield Classic 350, Hunter 350, Continental GT 650, or Yamaha MT-15.

**Does this work as a mobile phone or credit card EMI calculator?**
Yes, approximately. Enter the phone's price (for an iPhone or any mobile EMI purchase) or your outstanding bill (for a credit card EMI conversion) as the loan amount, along with the interest rate and tenure your issuer offers, to estimate the EMI and total cost.

**What's the difference between a flat EMI calculator and a reducing balance EMI calculator?**
A flat or simple interest calculator charges interest on the full original principal for the whole tenure, while a reducing balance calculator — the method this tool and virtually every regulated lender use — charges interest only on the outstanding balance each month, which is significantly cheaper for the same quoted rate.

**Can I calculate a used car loan or two-wheeler loan EMI?**
Yes. Used vehicle loans use the same reducing-balance EMI formula, typically at a slightly higher interest rate than new-vehicle loans — enter the loan amount, rate, and tenure your lender has quoted.

Yes. Set Compounding Frequency to Daily reducing balance in Advanced options — common for gold loans and some NBFC products — to see the marginally higher effective EMI compared to standard monthly reducing balance.

#### Frequently asked questions (24)

**What is a loan calculator?**
A loan calculator works out what a loan costs. Given an amount, an interest rate and a repayment period it computes the monthly instalment, the total interest over the full term and the total amount repaid, and breaks the repayment down month by month.

**What is EMI?**
EMI stands for Equated Monthly Instalment — a fixed monthly payment that covers both interest and principal. The amount stays the same each month, but its composition shifts: early instalments are mostly interest, later ones mostly principal.

**How is EMI calculated?**
EMI = P × r × (1+r)ⁿ ÷ ((1+r)ⁿ − 1), where P is the loan amount, r is the monthly interest rate (annual rate divided by 12 and by 100) and n is the number of monthly instalments. The formula produces the fixed payment that repays the loan exactly over n months.

**What is the loan EMI formula?**
For a reducing-balance loan the formula is EMI = P × r × (1+r)ⁿ ÷ ((1+r)ⁿ − 1). At a zero interest rate this degenerates, and the instalment is simply the loan amount divided by the number of months.

**How does the interest rate affect EMI?**
A higher rate raises both the instalment and the total interest, and the effect compounds over longer tenures. On ₹10,00,000 over five years, moving from 8% to 12% raises the EMI from about ₹20,276 to about ₹22,244 and the total interest from roughly ₹2,16,584 to ₹3,34,667.

**How does tenure affect EMI?**
A longer tenure lowers the monthly instalment but raises the total interest, because the balance stays outstanding for longer. On ₹10,00,000 at 8.5%, five years costs about ₹2,30,992 in interest while fifteen years costs about ₹7,72,530 — more than three times as much for a smaller monthly payment.

**How can I reduce the total interest on a loan?**
Shorten the tenure, negotiate a lower rate, borrow less, or make prepayments. Prepayments made early in the term save the most, because interest each month is charged on the outstanding balance and reducing it early removes interest from every remaining month.

**What is an amortization schedule?**
A month-by-month table showing how each instalment splits between interest and principal and what balance remains afterwards. It is the clearest way to see that a fixed EMI does very different work at the start of a loan than at the end.

**What is principal?**
The principal is the amount actually borrowed, before any interest. Each instalment repays a slice of it; the outstanding principal is what remaining interest is charged on.

**What is total interest?**
The sum of the interest portions of every instalment over the life of the loan — the price of borrowing. Total payment is the principal plus this figure.

**Can I calculate a personal loan EMI?**
Yes. Personal loans are ordinary reducing-balance loans, so the same calculation applies. Enter the amount, the rate quoted to you and the tenure. Personal loans usually carry shorter tenures and higher rates than secured loans.

**Can I calculate a home loan EMI?**
Yes, and the prepayment section is particularly useful for one, since interest dominates the early years of a twenty-year loan. For housing-specific inputs, ToolAdda also has a dedicated home loan calculator .

**Can I calculate a car loan EMI?**
Yes. Enter the amount financed after your down payment rather than the vehicle's full price, since you only pay interest on what you actually borrow. There is also a dedicated car loan calculator that handles down payment and on-road cost.

**Can I calculate an education loan EMI?**
You can calculate the repayment phase. Education loans often include a moratorium during study, and interest behaviour during that period depends entirely on the lender's terms, so this calculator does not model it — enter the balance at the point repayment begins.

**Can I calculate loan prepayment savings?**
Yes. Add an extra monthly amount or a one-time prepayment and the calculator runs the loan twice — once without and once with the prepayment — reporting the interest saved and how many months earlier the loan closes.

**What is the difference between reducing tenure and reducing EMI?**
After a prepayment a lender can either keep your instalment the same and end the loan sooner, or keep the end date and lower the instalment. Reducing the tenure saves considerably more interest; reducing the EMI improves monthly cash flow. The calculator models both.

**What happens if the interest rate is 0%?**
The standard EMI formula divides by zero at a zero rate, so this calculator handles that case separately: the instalment becomes the loan amount divided by the number of months, and the total interest is zero. ₹1,00,000 over 60 months at 0% is ₹1,666.67 a month, shown as ₹1,667 with the difference absorbed in the final instalment.

**Can I use a custom interest rate?**
Yes. Any rate from 0% to 100% is accepted, including decimals such as 8.75% or 10.49%. The rate you enter is used exactly as typed and is never rounded.

**Why does my last instalment differ slightly?**
Interest is rounded to whole paise every month, so tiny rounding differences accumulate across the term. Lenders absorb these in the final instalment, and so does this calculator — which is why the schedule always closes at exactly zero.

**Does this calculator guarantee loan approval?**
No. It performs arithmetic on the numbers you enter. Lenders assess income stability, credit history, existing obligations and their own policies, none of which a calculator can evaluate.

**Does this calculator include lender fees?**
Only the processing fee you enter, which is added to the total cost of borrowing but not amortized, since such fees are usually charged upfront. Insurance, documentation charges, prepayment penalties and taxes are not modelled — check the lender's schedule of charges.

**Is my financial data uploaded anywhere?**
No. Every calculation runs in your browser and no request is made. The amounts you enter are not stored — only your view preferences, such as whether the schedule shows years or months, are remembered.

**Can I export the amortization schedule?**
Yes. The CSV export writes every instalment with raw unformatted numbers, so it opens cleanly in Excel, Google Sheets or LibreOffice without currency symbols or digit grouping breaking the columns.

**Is this loan calculator free?**
Yes. No sign-up, no limits and no paid tier.
